summary: Iteration 3 full-stack testing of the 5 new PitStock features (Purchase Orders, Invoices, Profit Report, Barcode batch print, Repair/Job Cards). Backend: 19 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py — 17 passed, 2 failed. Frontend: Playwright e2e as owner (job card create -> auto-open editor -> add part -> labor/status -> save -> create invoice; PO suggest -> draft -> send -> receive; invoice from OUT transactions + mark paid; Reports Profit tab KPIs/tables/presets; Inventory multi-select batch print) and as staff (role guard). All flows worked; 1 real business-logic bug and 2 minor issues found.

critical.issue: grand_total/parts_total are recalculated by _recalc_repair() only on the returned object and never persisted with the $set. After updating labor_charge, the DB keeps the stale grand_total. Reproduced: part 21.00 + labor 40.00 -> editor dialog shows 61.00 (response), but GET /api/repairs and the Job cards grid show 21.00, while the generated invoice subtotal is 61.00. Fix: include parts_total/grand_total in the $set inside update_repair (recompute after applying labor_charge).

minor.issue: Invalid date string raises ValueError from datetime.fromisoformat -> 500 Internal Server Error. Should return 400/422 with a clear message.
Not atomic: transaction insert + inventory update + card update are separate awaits with no rollback; a mid-way failure leaves stock and card out of sync. Low likelihood, note for hardening.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True (invalid combo for credentialed browser requests; works only because the app uses Bearer tokens in localStorage). Also no httpOnly cookie login, no brute-force lockout, and startup seed_admin does not update an existing admin's password. bcrypt hashes verified as $2b$12$. These are pre-existing design choices, not iteration-3 regressions.

ui_bugs.issue: Card delete button uses 'opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100' but the parent <Card> has no 'group' class, so the trash icon is permanently invisible (still occupies/clicks at bottom-right, so a user can delete a card by accident without seeing the control). Add 'group' to the Card className or make the button always visible.
Grid 'Total' shows the stale persisted grand_total (21,00 €) after labor is saved, while the dialog shows 61,00 € — user-visible symptom of the backend PUT /api/repairs bug.
The per-card trash button has no data-testid, so card deletion cannot be automated.

integration_issues.flow: Staff loading Job cards / Repairs page
integration_issues.issue: Repairs.jsx unconditionally calls GET /api/users which returns 403 for staff; the error is swallowed by .catch(() => []) but logs a console 403 on every staff visit. Gate the query on role to keep the console clean.

issues: FROM/TO use native <input type=date> browser date pickers (profit-start / profit-end) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere — inconsistent with the design system guideline.
Radix warning: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (accessibility) on both the new-card and editor dialogs.

action_items: HIGH: Persist parts_total/grand_total in PUT /api/repairs/{id} so the card list total matches the dialog and the generated invoice.
MINOR: Validate start/end date params in GET /api/reports/profit and return 400 instead of 500.
MINOR: Add 'group' class to the job-card <Card> (or remove opacity-0) so the delete button is visible; add a data-testid to it.
MINOR: Skip the /api/users query for staff on the Repairs page to avoid the 403 console error.
OPTIONAL: Replace native date inputs on the Profit tab with the shadcn Calendar component.
critical_code_review_comments: update_repair() calls _recalc_repair() after re-reading the doc but writes nothing back — response and DB diverge (root cause of the totals bug).
server.py is 1065 lines; POs, invoices, repairs and reports should be split into routers/modules.
Repair part add/remove and PO receive mutate three collections without transactions/rollback.
reports/profit does datetime.fromisoformat on untrusted query params without try/except.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all 5 new flows functional; 1 stale-total display bug + hidden delete button)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iteration3.py -v. Two known failures: test_profit_report_bad_date_format (500 on bad date) and test_repair_full_lifecycle (asserts grand_total persisted after labor update). Both are real product bugs, not test bugs — re-run after the main agent fixes them. Frontend flows verified working: nav-repairs job card lifecycle incl. auto-opening editor, po-suggest/create/send/receive, invoice-create from OUT txns + mark paid, tab-profit KPIs + presets, inventory select-<sku>/select-all + batch-print-button (click executes, popup blocked in headless), and staff role guard (/purchase-orders redirects to /, no PO/Staff/Settings nav for staff).
rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/repairs/{id} builds an `updates` dict from the payload, writes it, re-reads the card and then calls _recalc_repair(card) which mutates only the in-memory dict returned to the client. parts_total/grand_total are therefore only persisted by the add-part/remove-part handlers, which do include them in their $set. Consequence: any labor_charge change leaves a stale grand_total in db.repairs, visible in GET /api/repairs and the job-card grid, and inconsistent with the invoice generated from the same card (invoice recomputes from parts_used + labor_charge). Fix: after applying updates, recompute parts_total/grand_total and include them in the $set.
